hints.text: There are two operations here and no parentheses. Which one does the order of operations say comes first?
Multiplication comes before addition, so work out $2 \times 4$ first. Then add $3$ to that product.

explanation: With no parentheses, the order of operations says to multiply before you add.
Do the multiplication part of the expression first: $2 \times 4 = 8$.
Now the expression is $3 + 8$, and adding gives $11$.
The value is $11$. Going left to right would give $20$, which is wrong.
